title: cli: the unevaluated-expression gate walks `children` only, so nodes under renderer-owned slot keys (tab `items[].content`, `page:card` `body`/`footer`, page `regions[].components[]`) are not judged (#4795 follow-up)
body:
Filed by the director seat (objectstack#12708, `session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`) from its contract review of PR #11126 (objectui#4795, ruling item 2). ⛔ Not a claim. The fact is stated in that PR's own Acceptance notes and docs page; this card gives it a carrier.

## What happens

`findUnbindableTextExpressions` (`packages/cli/src/utils/unbindable-text-expressions.ts`, PR #11126) walks the document root and what `children` holds — the one composition key `BaseSchema` declares (`packages/types/src/base.ts:349`), the same single spelling core's `validateChildren` and the SDUI parser's `CHILD_LIST_KEY` follow. `SchemaRenderer` does not recurse on its own: each renderer hands nodes back through keys of its own. So component nodes that sit under a renderer-owned slot key are not judged:

- a tab's `items[].content`, `panels[].content`;
- `page:card`'s `body` / `footer`;
- a page's `regions[].components[]`;
- carousel `items`, `trigger`, `header`, `footer`.

A `${…}` on `title` / `label` / `value` / `description` of such a node still reaches the user as literal text, unrefused — the defect ruling 5406135987 / 5479466110 wants loud at build time. The gate fails quiet in the safe direction (it never produces a false refusal), which is why PR #11126 is right to ship as it is.

## Why it is not a hand-kept list

A walk over every object with a string `type` refuses a form's `fields[]` entries, a grid's `columns[]`, `{ "type": "multiple" }` selection modes — false refusals, measured (PR #11126, ablation 2). A hand-kept list of slot keys in the CLI would be a second copy of what the protocol does not declare, and would drift from the renderers.

## The mechanical fix (for the dispatch, not a ruling)

Declare the per-type node-slot keys once, next to `BaseSchema.children` in `@object-ui/types`, derived from the renderers that hand nodes back (or read from the registry the way `isKnownSchemaType` is derived), and have three consumers read it: the `objectui check` gate, core's `validateChildren` and the SDUI parser. Prior art for the page family: objectstack's conversions walker declares `COMPONENT_CHILD_KEYS = ['children', 'body', 'footer']` and the `page:tabs` / `page:accordion` `items[].children` shape (`packages/spec/src/conversions/walk.ts:244`, `mapComponentTree`).

`Clause-②: yes` at claim if a new declaration is published on `@object-ui/types`; the gate's accept set then narrows again for the nodes it newly reaches (the docs page sentence "every node its `children` hold" moves with it).
